remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this thoughtfully designed townhouse nestled in Stamford's vibrant Springdale neighborhood. The open main level welcomes you with a spacious, sun-filled living room that flows seamlessly into the dining area, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Sliding glass doors open to a private balcony, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or unwind in the evening. The eat-in kitchen boasts updated cabinetry, sleek countertops, and ample space for cooking and gathering. A convenient half bath completes this level. Upstairs, the bright and spacious, primary suite includes a walk-in closet and private full bath, while a second bedroom with double closet and full hall bath adds flexibility. The fully finished lower level offers endless possibilities with a large open room, separate laundry area, extra storage, and direct access to the one car attached garage. Just minutes from local shops, top rated restaurants, and the Springdale train station this home offers both convenience and functionality. Highest & Best by Monday (4/14) at 6PM.
